Title: Island of Yiaros and adding votes

Messages.Author: Frederic Genest
Messages.Body:
I think I already asked this question once, but can't find the answer.
Also, I can't find a message that talks about it in the group, so here
goes:

Can a Bewitching Oration be added during combat to give a Ventrue
+hand damage using the Island of Yiaros? While the combat occured
following the block of an attempt at calling a political action, I
don't think so since the BO is only usable during a "referendum" (the
voting part), and we are obviously not there. :-)

Seems like there should be a message in the newsgroup saying we could,
but I can't find it. :-(

Thanks!

Ouch.
I think by rights this should be limited to "a Camarilla vampire" you
control, if not
"a Ventrue you control". As it is, a Regent could use it...
I think that technically only the +2 from a BW may actually be aggravated,
if that weird ruling I read about Uncontrollable Rage holds true...

So many posts and nobody was anal enough to quote the card. I'm impressed!
Here goes (Master: Unique location, requires a Ventrue, and costs two pool)
____________
Tap to give a vampire you control +X <strength> for one strike, where X is
the number of votes the vampire has (e.g., a prince gets +2 <strength>).
This card may be burned by any vampire as a D action; Brujah get -1 stealth
when attempting that action.
____________

I still think the fact that it's a location makes it vulnerable enough, and
having the "burn as a D action" as well makes it a bit too fragile.

-Michael
